answer: Each agent must stake tokens and periodically broadcast a signed beacon from a unique hardware root; peers verify liveness by challenging the agent to anchor its identity on a public knoll of witnessed checkpoints. Sybils must buy and maintain distinct hardware per identity, and any duplicate beacon collapses the stake, so forging N identities costs N stakes plus N devices, while honest agents harbor only one root each.
